## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -31.64%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND shows fear receding and SPY/TLT (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +5.98%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND plus mixed sector flows indicate money rotating, not fleeing.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -31.64%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Credit stress flagged higher: HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +1.36%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.22% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND — HYG/LQD signal noted as stress rising. Stocks vs bonds improving: SPY (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +5.26%) ABOVE TREND contributing to rotation.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-easing: UUP (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -1.61%) RECOVERY shows a softer dollar and Yield Curve (1W: -0.22% | 1M: -1.89%) → flat BELOW TREND keeps conditions mixed while duration preference remains subdued.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals/financials and materials leading: XLF (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +12.12%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (Materials) (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +12.26%) ABOVE TREND; Tech still strong: XLK (1W: +2.16% | 1M: +6.84%) ABOVE TREND. Weakness/short-term pullbacks: XLE (1W: -1.33% | 1M: +0.35%) CORRECTION and XLU (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -2.78%) BELOW TREND.

5. US vs Global?
US leadership intact: SPY (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +5.26%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +5.86%) ABOVE TREND; EM outperformance signs but mixed: EEM (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +3.15%) ABOVE TREND while China tech KWEB (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -4.06%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation healthy: ARKK (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +13.57%) ABOVE TREND, IWM (1W: +0.99% | 1M: +11.05%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +2.94% | 1M: +2.31%) ABOVE TREND show risk-tolerant flows.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals rallying: SLV (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +36.46%) ABOVE TREND and PPLT (1W: +17.69% | 1M: +39.64%) ABOVE TREND; industrial commodities supportive: CPER (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed-to-soft: BNO (1W: +2.51% | 1M: -0.83%) RECOVERY but XLE (1W: -1.33% | 1M: +0.35%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: -4.90% | 1M: -17.82%) BELOW TREND show uneven demand signals.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +5.26%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +2.16% | 1M: +6.84%) ABOVE TREND support risk-on rotations; DIVERGENCE: multiple sector CORRECTIONS (XRT, XLE, XLP) indicate 1W weakness vs 1M strength — minor divergence but monitor for escalation.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor rotation into Financials and Materials given relative strength (XLF (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +12.12%) ABOVE TREND; XLB (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +12.26%) ABOVE TREND) and maintain Tech exposure while reducing exposure to Utilities and weak Energy (XLU (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -2.78%) BELOW TREND; XLE (1W: -1.33% | 1M: +0.35%) CORRECTION).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Materials XLB (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +12.26%) ABOVE TREND, Financials XLF (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +12.12%) ABOVE TREND, Semis SOXX (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +13.50%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Utilities XLU (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -2.78%) BELOW TREND, Energy XLE (1W: -1.33% | 1M: +0.35%) CORRECTION.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +36.46%) ABOVE TREND and Platinum PPLT (1W: +17.69% | 1M: +39.64%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -4.90% | 1M: -17.82%) BELOW TREND, Agriculture SOYB (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (current VXX (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -31.64%) BELOW TREND) for complacency reset; HYG/LQD threshold ~0.80 (credit health watch) as HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +1.36%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.22% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND; XLK/XLF ~2.62 (current 2.6240) as growth vs value pivot; SPY/TLT ~8.0 (current SPY/TLT (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +5.98%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND) to confirm equity dominance.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive with VXX (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -31.64%) ↓ falling and SPY/TLT (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +5.98%) ↑ rising supporting a shift, not a panic. Financials and Materials showing strength (XLF (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +12.12%) ABOVE TREND; XLB (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +12.26%) ABOVE TREND). Key risk: rising credit stress signal (HYG/LQD) and several sector CORRECTIONS (XLE, XRT, XLP) to monitor.
